announcements.title: Season 1 Standardized Bedrock Tier Testing is Live!
announcements.content:
Welcome to the official Bedrock Union Competitive Gaming Platform!
Official 1v1 testing and calibration is open for Bedfight, Skywars, Mace, and Fireball Fight.

Join our official Discord community to queue with certified evaluators.
announcements.summary: Testing queues are officially open for Bedfight, Skywars, Mace, and Fireball Fight on Discord.
announcements.author: Bedrock Union Owner
